title: Okanagan Valley Wine Tasting with Lunch
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the rich wine culture of Kelowna on a small-group tour that takes you to four of the region's finest vineyards. With a knowledgeable guide handling transportation and tasting fees included, enjoy a day filled with exquisite wines and beautiful vineyard views. This tour is perfect for wine enthusiasts looking to deepen their appreciation of Canadian wines while enjoying a relaxed and intimate atmosphere.

- Visit four acclaimed vineyards in the stunning Kelowna region
- Enjoy included tasting fees for a variety of local wines
- Small-group setting ensures personalized attention from your guide
- Convenient hotel pick-up allows you to relax and savor the experience
